questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions ahead on or near the road. They are usually diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Proceed only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs indicate a sharp curve in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, the road curves sharply to the left. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs display traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign tells you that parking is not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with the palm up and then swings their arm upward, it signals riders to increase speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road ahead will create an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or ride near traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and increase your following distance in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle height exceeds the clearance shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing with a steep slope. Low vehicles may scrape or get caught on the tracks at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will be entering the road from the right side ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with traffic signals. It tells drivers turning left on a green light that they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws you must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when wet. Slow down and be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is coming up. The road splits into separate one-way lanes. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then curves left. Reduce speed and stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Stop signs are eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop and look both ways for pedestrians and other vehicles. Only move when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign forbids passing. You cannot pass another vehicle where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is forbidden. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is near. Watch for children and slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot drive in this direction. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Be careful and adjust your speed if conditions are wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign means there is low clearance ahead. Tall vehicles may not fit. Reduce speed and be cautious.
